sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Accepted: the candidate preserves the required ship target and canonical namespace, constrains the applicability selector to exactly one boolean, requires polarOperationCoverage and all three applicable document-coverage indicators when polar operation is true, and permits the false-applicability branch without imposing document requirements.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Add sh:maxCount 1 to shipOperatesInPolarWaters in the true branch and to each of the three document-coverage properties. As written, multiple values can include a required true value alongside contradictory false values, allowing an inconsistent RDF state to pass the conditional check.

Preserve the earlier maxCount repairs. Also add sh:maxCount 1 to shipOperatesInPolarWaters in the false branch (or constrain the selector once outside sh:or); otherwise a node containing both false and contradictory true values satisfies sh:hasValue false and the conditional can pass an inconsistent applicability state.

The candidate omits the declared polarOperationCoverage concept named by the non-empty comparisonModel and legacy indexed terms, so it does not faithfully encode the required coverage result. Add nltl:polarOperationCoverage with its canonical datatype/cardinality and require it, together with the three applicable document-coverage properties, in the true applicability branch; retain the previously required maxCount 1 constraints, including maxCount 1 on the selector in the false branch or once outside sh:or. Do not activate the vocabulary matcher because polarOperationCoverage is already supplied canonically.

Accepted: the candidate preserves the required ship target and canonical namespace, constrains the applicability selector to exactly one boolean, requires polarOperationCoverage and all three applicable document-coverage indicators when polar operation is true, and permits the false-applicability branch without imposing document requirements.
